title: 5 Stocks to Buy BEFORE the 2027 AI Bank Crash
creator: Joseph Hogue, CFA
summary: Joseph Hogue argues AI agents (spurred by Meta's Muse launch, ~3M downloads by late September) will remove the friction that keeps tens of millions of customers in legacy banks paying 0.01-0.04% on deposits, forcing traditional banks into a damned-if-you-do choice: lose deposits or match ~3.5% rates and crater net interest income. His back-of-envelope stress test puts the industry hit at up to $52B, with JPMorgan (a $900B market cap bank paying 0.01%) risking ~$30B of its $95B interest income and Citigroup ~$5.5B. He ranks five legacy banks as avoids - Citigroup, JPMorgan, U.S. Bancorp, Wells Fargo and Bank of America - though he names Bank of America (1.37x book, 0.71x PEG, 8.5% expected revenue growth) the best relative deal of the group if buying the selloff. His five buys are the fintech beneficiaries: SoFi (32% expected revenue growth, 0.69x PEG, "a great deal"), Coinbase (3.5% USDC rewards, tokenization tailwind), Robinhood (31% growth, 2.4x PEG), PayPal (1.4x PEG, slower 4.4% growth but cheap) and Ally Financial (0.85x book, 0.3x PEG, the value pick). He is transparent that the stress test is crude - banks could respond with fees or funding shifts - and that the shift plays out over years, not weeks. Calls: SOFI/COIN/HOOD/PYPL/ALLY BUY (PYPL and ALLY reiterations); C/JPM/USB/WFC/BAC AVOID - BAC is a stance flip from his Oct 1 BUY. The video includes a sponsored Monarch money-app segment.
